title: A day on Riley's {{device}}
subtitle: Riley can always see how much time is left and what comes next.

steps.say: It's afternoon, and Riley has used most of today's two hours.
Bedtime is set on the family dashboard. Riley sees it coming instead of being cut off by surprise.
With a quarter of an hour to go, Temperance gives Riley a heads-up.
Dinner's ready, so a parent pauses Riley from the dashboard.
The {{device}} says why the internet stopped, so there's nothing to argue with.
After dinner, the pause ends and Riley picks up right where they left off.
